nodes.label: Two Distinct Grading Scales
nodes.rationale: pred() returns a predicate plus Tuntas/Remedial completion status using 90/80/75 thresholds, while letter() returns A/B/C/D using 82/75/65. They are deliberately kept separate because the predicate/completion view and the letter-grade view use different cut-offs in the prototype.

nodes.label: Focus and Caret Preservation Across Re-render
nodes.norm_label: focus and caret preservation across re-render
nodes.rationale: Because every keystroke triggers a full innerHTML replacement, render(keep) captures the active input by placeholder plus selectionStart and restores focus and caret offset after repainting so search typing is uninterrupted.

nodes.label: Single Mutable Global State
nodes.rationale: One `st` object holds page, per-page pagination, search text, filters, selection and sidebar collapse state. Centralizing it makes the whole UI trivially re-renderable from a single render() call and mirrors what later becomes React context.

nodes.label: Inline onclick Global Dispatch
nodes.rationale: Every page/form function is declared at top-level script scope so inline onclick="..." attributes resolve them on window without any binding layer. This keeps the prototype a single dependency-free file at the cost of no component isolation.

nodes.label: Non-Validating Login Gate
nodes.rationale: login() only checks that the username and password fields are non-empty and that the default mock credentials are prefilled. There is no credential check, session, or token; login exists only to gate the shell behind a login screen.

nodes.label: Academic Result Nav Alias for Transcript
nodes.norm_label: academic result nav alias for transcript
nodes.rationale: shell() maps the 'result' page to the 'results' nav key so the Academic Result item stays highlighted on both the roster page and the single-student transcript page.

nodes.label: No Persistence / Refresh Resets State
nodes.rationale: All datasets are plain in-memory arrays reassigned by handlers; nothing is written to localStorage. A refresh intentionally returns the user to the login screen with seed data, which is the desired prototype behavior.

nodes.label: Single Toast with 2.4s Auto-Dismiss
nodes.rationale: toast() reuses one #toast host and stores the timer on the function object so a new message replaces the current one and resets the 2400ms dismiss timer.

nodes.label: Deterministic Synthetic Transcript Scores
nodes.rationale: result() derives five subject breakdowns arithmetically from the student index and average instead of storing real data, keeping the transcript visually populated while all inputs remain deterministic and stable across re-renders.
